mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, code, process_id, name, description, image, inactive, production_outsource, purchase_outsource, inspection, packing, stock_management, previous_stock_out, final_process, planned_equipment, actual_equipment_required FROM ( SELECT 'g:' || group_id AS id, NULL AS parent_id, group_id::text AS code, NULL::bigint AS process_id, name, description, NULL AS image, inactive, false AS production_outsource, false AS purchase_outsource, false AS inspection, false AS packing, false AS stock_management, false AS previous_stock_out, false AS final_process, false AS planned_equipment, false AS actual_equipment_required, group_id AS group_key, 0 AS kind, 0 AS sort_seq, group_id AS entry_key FROM tb_process_group WHERE tenant_id = #{value} UNION ALL SELECT 'm:' || m.map_id, 'g:' || m.group_id, p.process_id::text, p.process_id, p.name, p.description, p.image, p.inactive, p.production_outsource, p.purchase_outsource, p.inspection, p.packing, p.stock_management, p.previous_stock_out, p.final_process, p.planned_equipment, p.actual_equipment_required, m.group_id, 1, m.sort_seq, m.map_id FROM tb_process_group_process m JOIN tb_process p ON p.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND p.process_id = m.process_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{value} ) t ORDER BY group_key, kind, sort_seq, entry_key

SELECT 'p:' || process_id AS id, NULL AS parent_id, process_id::text AS code, process_id, name, description, image, inactive, production_outsource, purchase_outsource, inspection, packing, stock_management, previous_stock_out, final_process, planned_equipment, actual_equipment_required FROM tb_process WHERE tenant_id = #{value} ORDER BY process_id
INSERT INTO tb_process_group (tenant_id, name, description, inactive) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{row.name}, #{row.description}, #{row.inactive}) RETURNING group_id

INSERT INTO tb_process_group_process (tenant_id, group_id, process_id, sort_seq) SELECT #{tenantId}, g.group_id, p.process_id, 0 FROM tb_process_group g JOIN tb_process p ON p.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND p.process_id = #{processId} AND p.inactive = false WHERE g.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND g.group_id = #{groupId} ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, group_id, process_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING map_id

INSERT INTO tb_process (tenant_id, name, description, image, inactive, production_outsource, purchase_outsource, inspection, packing, stock_management, previous_stock_out, final_process, planned_equipment, actual_equipment_required) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{row.name}, #{row.description}, #{row.image}, #{row.inactive}, #{row.productionOutsource}, #{row.purchaseOutsource}, #{row.inspection}, #{row.packing}, #{row.stockManagement}, #{row.previousStockOut}, #{row.finalProcess}, #{row.plannedEquipment}, #{row.actualEquipmentRequired}) RETURNING process_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_process SET name = #{row.name}, description = #{row.description}, image = #{row.image}, inactive = #{row.inactive}, production_outsource = #{row.productionOutsource}, purchase_outsource = #{row.purchaseOutsource}, inspection = #{row.inspection}, packing = #{row.packing}, stock_management = #{row.stockManagement}, previous_stock_out = #{row.previousStockOut}, final_process = #{row.finalProcess}, planned_equipment = #{row.plannedEquipment}, actual_equipment_required = #{row.actualEquipmentRequired}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND process_id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_process_group g WHERE g.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND g.group_id = #{id} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_process_group_process m WHERE m.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND m.group_id = g.group_id)
DELETE FROM tb_process_group_process WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND map_id = #{id}

DELETE FROM tb_process p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.process_id = #{id} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_process_group_process m WHERE m.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND m.process_id = p.process_id)
